t0342-01.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
t0342-01.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same black specks while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

t0342-02.gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
t0342-02.rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
